title: Vinod Texworld IPO Details
intro:
Vinod Texworld IPO is a fixed issue price of ₹42.83 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 45.56 lakh shares of ₹42.83 crore.

Vinod Texworld IPO opens for subscription on Sep 9, 2026 and closes on Sep 11, 2026. The allotment for the Vinod Texworld IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 15, 2026. Vinod Texworld IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 17, 2026.

Vinod Texworld IPO is set final issue price at ₹94 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,25,600 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,38,400.

Novus Capital Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Vinod Texworld IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2012, Vinod Texworld Limited is an integrated textile company specialising in the manufacturing, processing, and supplying of a diverse range of textile products to both domestic and international markets.
The company's core operations centre on the essential processes of dyeing and printing greige fabric, which is subsequently marketed and sold.

The company manages the entire production lifecycle, ensuring quality control and rapid adaptation to evolving market demands, from sourcing Greige Fabric to the final production of Dyed and Printed fabrics.
The product range is versatile, covering multiple fabric types: Cotton fabrics, Polyester fabrics and Blended fabrics

Vinod Texworld Limited operates a dedicated manufacturing facility situated on an owned land area of approximately 5,949 square meters. The facility has an aggregate installed capacity of around 22,500,000 Meters/annum .
The company maintains a strong domestic network across various Indian states, including Gujarat, Punjab, Haryana, Delhi, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, and West Bengal.
The company employed a total of 103 employees as of August 31, 2025.

faqs.question: How to apply in Vinod Texworld IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Vinod Texworld IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Vinod Texworld IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Vinod Texworld IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Vinod Texworld IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for Vinod Texworld IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Vinod Texworld IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Vinod Texworld IPO will be done on Tuesday, September 15, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Wed, Sep 16, 2026 . Check the Vinod Texworld IPO allotment status .

faqs.answer: The Vinod Texworld IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Thu, Sep 17, 2026 .
